description: Language-neutral fixture proving Python (evaluation_feedback.py's classify_feedback_eligibility) and TypeScript (feedback-grade-queries.ts's computeEligibilityWindow) agree on first-exclusion-reason precedence and on recency/cap behavior. Each precedence case is one complete GradePopulationRow (Python field names; the TypeScript PopulationRow subset is a strict subset of these fields) plus the expected eligibility status/reason. Each cap case is a small newest-first population plus a max_grades policy value and the expected per-row status/reason.

precedence_cases.name: eligible_baseline
precedence_cases.description: A fully valid, linked, contract-conformant row with no override clears every check.

precedence_cases.name: schema_version_excludes
precedence_cases.description: A legacy (v1) grade is excluded before any other check runs.

precedence_cases.name: needs_regrade_excludes
precedence_cases.description: A grade flagged needs_regrade is excluded regardless of its content.

precedence_cases.name: missing_evaluation_linkage_excludes
precedence_cases.description: No evaluations row resolves for the grade (evaluation_id is null).

precedence_cases.name: mismatched_post_id_excludes
precedence_cases.description: The linked evaluation's post_id disagrees with the grade's own post_id.

precedence_cases.name: mismatched_scan_id_excludes
precedence_cases.description: The linked evaluation's scan_id disagrees with the grade's own non-null scan_id.

precedence_cases.name: null_grade_scan_id_skips_scan_identity_check
precedence_cases.description: A grade with no scan_id (e.g. web-sourced) makes no claim about scan identity, so a mismatch there must not exclude it.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_draft_project_mismatch
precedence_cases.description: The draft's project_key disagrees with its evaluation's project_key.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_draft_dossier_summary_mismatch
precedence_cases.description: The draft's dossier_summary_id disagrees with its evaluation's.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_draft_dossier_revision_mismatch
precedence_cases.description: The draft's dossier_revision disagrees with its evaluation's.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_draft_posture_mismatch
precedence_cases.description: The draft's posture disagrees with its evaluation's posture.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_accept_with_dimensions
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: an accept grade must carry null dimensions.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_fail_missing_note
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: a fail grade requires non-null dimensions and failure_note.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_relevance_action_conflict
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: action_judgment=accept requires relevance_judgment=correct.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_factual_support_missing_contradicting_evidence
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: a contradicted factual_support dimension requires non-null contradicting evidence.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_posture_dimension_missing_should_have_been
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: a posture dimension requires posture_should_have_been.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_non_array_dimensions
precedence_cases.description: Malformed dimensions: a non-array value fails the shared schema's array requirement.

precedence_cases.name: shared_contract_invalid_posture_should_have_been_equals_evaluation_posture
precedence_cases.description: Causal schema failure: posture_should_have_been must differ from the evaluation's own posture (a no-op correction is not a valid causal claim).

precedence_cases.name: no_draft_comment_skips_shared_contract_check
precedence_cases.description: With no draft_comments row for the evaluation, the draft/evaluation linkage fallback check never runs.

precedence_cases.name: manual_exclude_excludes
precedence_cases.description: An operator usage override in mode=exclude excludes an otherwise-eligible grade.

precedence_cases.name: precedence_schema_version_beats_needs_regrade
precedence_cases.description: Precedence: schema_version is checked first and wins over a simultaneous needs_regrade.

precedence_cases.name: precedence_needs_regrade_beats_missing_linkage
precedence_cases.description: Precedence: needs_regrade is checked before evaluation linkage and wins.

precedence_cases.name: precedence_missing_linkage_beats_shared_contract
precedence_cases.description: Precedence: missing evaluation linkage is checked before the shared contract check and wins even when the draft would also fail it.

precedence_cases.name: precedence_mismatched_identity_beats_shared_contract
precedence_cases.description: Precedence: mismatched evaluation identity is checked before the shared contract check and wins even when the draft would also fail it.

precedence_cases.name: precedence_shared_contract_beats_manual_exclude
precedence_cases.description: Precedence: shared_contract_invalid is checked before manual_exclude and wins even when the operator has also excluded the grade.

cap_cases.name: cap_marks_older_valid_rows_eligible_cap
cap_cases.description: Three otherwise-eligible rows, newest-first; max_grades=2 keeps the newest two eligible and caps the oldest.

cap_cases.name: excluded_rows_do_not_count_against_cap
cap_cases.description: A globally-excluded row (schema_version) does not consume a cap slot; both remaining valid rows stay eligible under max_grades=2.
